dog.description_text: Meet Victoria Sponge — New Arrival! Victoria Sponge just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQAhowQ0k7OTSahSORSO6euRASqgeGzH2Zk-hsVx6C3PgVQ?e=fAc47V Her foster says "She was pretty timid and hid at the beginning, but came over for pets on the first night... a little nervous around new people, but loves to be pet and is getting more comfortable. She is the most adorable cat in the world, and while she’s a little shy, she is so sweet and loves to be pet!" "A month in, she is so sweet and just the best cat. She can be a bit shy with new people, but in general, she absolutely loves being pet, playing with her toys, eating treats, getting zoomies, and finding new adorable places to sit." She is spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
